observation.summary: The call reached an AI voice agent instead of Bayview Post-Acute Center admissions, so the live availability questions could not be completed. To retry safely, I need a correct admissions or facility phone number for Bayview Post-Acute Center.
evidence: The answering party identified itself as an AI voice agent, not admissions staff.

No network, bed availability, wound VAC, IV antibiotic, coordinator, fax, or email details were obtained.
